goal: Implement RFC 4648 base32 encoding and decoding with padding.

steps.description: Implement encode: 5-byte groups to 8 characters (A-Z2-7), zero-bit padding, '=' to a multiple of 8
invariants: matches the RFC 4648 test vectors (empty through 'foobar')
output length is always a multiple of 8

steps.description: Implement decode: case-insensitive, strict padding, errors on bad characters or group lengths
invariants: decodes the RFC vectors and lowercase input
rejects invalid characters, misplaced padding, and groups not a multiple of 8
roundtrips pseudo-random data at every length 0..40
